title: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray) released
summary: Ubuntu 26.10 codenamed 'Stonking Stingray' has been officially released, continuing Ubuntu's semi-annual release cycle with updated packages, kernel upgrades, and new features for desktop and server users.
problem_solved: Provides users with the latest stable Ubuntu release featuring updated software, security patches, and improved system performance.
why_valuable: Ubuntu releases offer regular access to new Linux technologies, security updates, and improved hardware support for millions of users worldwide.
